Package com.hamsaye.chat.websocket.interceptors

Class WebSocketChannelInterceptor

java.lang.Object
com.hamsaye.chat.websocket.interceptors.WebSocketChannelInterceptor
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.messaging.support.ChannelInterceptor
@Service public class WebSocketChannelInterceptor extends Object implements org.springframework.messaging.support.ChannelInterceptor
Intercepts WebSocket messages to handle authentication and add additional headers.

This class implements ChannelInterceptor to process messages before they are sent. It handles WebSocket connection events by checking for the presence of necessary headers and performs authentication and logging. It sets a custom header for connection time.

  • Method Details

    • preSend

      public org.springframework.messaging.Message<?> preSend(org.springframework.messaging.Message<?> message, org.springframework.messaging.MessageChannel channel)
      Processes the message before sending it.

      This method is invoked before a message is sent. It checks if the WebSocket command is CONNECT and retrieves the user ID from the headers. It also sets a custom header for the connection time and logs the connection event.

      Specified by:
      preSend in interface org.springframework.messaging.support.ChannelInterceptor
      Parameters:
      message - the message to be processed
      channel - the message channel
      Returns:
      the processed message
      Since:
